+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+from .core import Command
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Parameter
+from .shell_completion import _is_incomplete_argument
+from .shell_completion import _is_incomplete_option
+from .shell_completion import _start_of_option
+
+
+def nonmutating_completion(
+    ctx: Context, args: list[str], incomplete: str
+) -> tuple[Command | Parameter, str]:
+    """Find the Click object that will handle the completion of the
+    incomplete value. Return the object and the incomplete value.
+
+    This behaves like :func:`click.shell_completion._resolve_incomplete`,
+    except that the caller's ``args`` list is never modified. This makes
+    it suitable for previewing a completion before the same args are
+    parsed later.
+
+    :param ctx: Invocation context for the command represented by
+        the parsed complete args.
+    :param args: List of complete args before the incomplete value.
+        Not modified.
+    :param incomplete: Value being completed. May be empty.
+    """
+    # Different shells treat an "=" between a long option name and
+    # value differently. Always split and discard the "=" to make
+    # completion easier, adding the name to a copy of the args.
+    if incomplete == "=":
+        incomplete = ""
+    elif "=" in incomplete and _start_of_option(ctx, incomplete):
+        name, _, incomplete = incomplete.partition("=")
+        args = copy.copy(args)
+        args.append(name)
+
+    # The "--" marker tells Click to stop treating values as options
+    # even if they start with the option character. If it hasn't been
+    # given and the incomplete arg looks like an option, the current
+    # command will provide option name completions.
+    if "--" not in args and _start_of_option(ctx, incomplete):
+        return ctx.command, incomplete
+
+    params = ctx.command.get_params(ctx)
+
+    # If the last complete arg is an option name with an incomplete
+    # value, the option will provide value completions.
+    for param in params:
+        if _is_incomplete_option(ctx, args, param):
+            return param, incomplete
+
+    # It's not an option name or value. The first argument without a
+    # parsed value will provide value completions.
+    for param in params:
+        if _is_incomplete_argument(ctx, param):
+            return param, incomplete
+
+    # There were no unparsed arguments, the command may be a group that
+    # will provide command name completions.
+    return ctx.command, incomplete
diff --git a/tests/test_nonmutating_completion.py b/tests/test_nonmutating_completion.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..8ded678
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_nonmutating_completion.py
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.core import Argument
+from click.core import Command
+from click.core import Option
+from click.nonmutating_completion import nonmutating_completion
+from click.shell_completion import _resolve_incomplete
+
+
+def _cli():
+    return Command(
+        "cli",
+        params=[
+            Option(["-n", "--name"]),
+            Option(["-f", "--flag"], is_flag=True),
+            Argument(["value"], required=False),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("args", "incomplete"),
+    [
+        ([], ""),
+        ([], "="),
+        ([], "--name=ab"),
+        ([], "-"),
+        (["--name"], ""),
+        (["--name"], "x"),
+        (["--"], "--name=ab"),
+        ([], "plain"),
+        ([], "x=y"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_matches_resolve_incomplete(args, incomplete):
+    cli = _cli()
+    ctx = cli.make_context("cli", list(args), resilient_parsing=True)
+    original = list(args)
+    preview = nonmutating_completion(ctx, original, incomplete)
+    assert original == args
+    expected = _resolve_incomplete(ctx, list(args), incomplete)
+    assert preview == expected
+
+
+def test_args_not_mutated_on_split():
+    cli = _cli()
+    ctx = cli.make_context("cli", [], resilient_parsing=True)
+    args = []
+    obj, incomplete = nonmutating_completion(ctx, args, "--name=ab")
+    assert args == []
+    assert obj.name == "name"
+    assert incomplete == "ab"
notes:
Added nonmutating_completion mirroring _resolve_incomplete step for step, but on an option=value split it appends the name to a shallow copy (copy.copy) of args instead of the caller list; tests compare its results to _resolve_incomplete and check args stay unchanged.
